scope: matched real-OWT probe of calibrated phase latch hold/release on existing ResourceCycle
question: Does an independent post-update fresh-batch outcome modulator improve or alter continual OWT training at matched state and model budget?

lean_scope.skipped: Explicit user request: run numerical/interface checks without additional Lean gate

data.tokenizer: UTF8 byte offset4 plus four specials; vocabulary260
data.domain_rule: length>=512; fixed character-density bottom/top training thirds; heldout uses training thresholds
data.test_split: hash checked only; never scored or used to set thresholds

model.kind: ordinary causal transformer optimizer testbed; not a derived CGB architecture
model.state: context128; no persistent neural state; optimizer state continues through every phase

experiment.initialization: same scratch Gaussian FP32 values; no projection, clipping, quantization or weight rewrite at optimizer construction
experiment.outcome_measurement: two extra no-grad forward passes on the next unseen batch; calibrated outcome gate with optional phase latch window 4

measurements.primary: first-pass prequential bits/actual UTF8 target byte, scored before each update
secondary: independent validation byte NLL per domain
measurements.units: actual bytes are targets4..259; boundary targets1/2 reported separately; no unicode-character BPB claim
measurements.replay: none: second A continues its fresh cursor; no repeated train targets within an arm
measurements.bridges: last target before each domain switch is the actual next domain's first input byte and is logged explicitly
measurements.checkpoint: model, optimizer physical state/RNG, pending gradients, all Torch RNGs, updates, stream cursors and metric accumulators
measurements.convergence: 5000 is a fixed budget, not assumed convergence; report last five validation values and slope; no early success stopping
measurements.interpretation: same unconstrained FP32 parameter family and exact same initialization; only optimizer changes; rates fixed, not assumed equally tuned

decision_rules.primary: paired prequential BPB and independent A/B validation
decision_rules.mechanism: outcome rho trajectory, evidence distribution, state bytes and extra forward cost
decision_rules.stop: 5000 updates per arm unless nonfinite values terminate a run

construction_H.groups: each actual matrix; non-matrices viewed as one-row matrices
construction_H.observer: per-parameter mean and RMS, matrix-level observation mass
construction_H.allocation: 8 Sinkhorn row/column scaling iterations; measure actual residual
construction_H.resource: floating per-row and per-column use/recovery; matrix-valued phase
construction_H.muon: torch.optim.Muon on all 2D tensors including embeddings and head, no weight decay
construction_H.hyperparameters: fixed before runs, same data budget; no tuning or claim of equally tuned rates

intervention.changed: outcome_modulation gate only; on arm updates group rho from fresh post-update outcome, off arm measures but ignores it
intervention.held_fixed: continuous FP32 model, initialization, Adam base, matrix allocation, reserve state, no weight decay, data and 5000 updates
intervention.fresh_protocol: lookahead batch is not used to form the current gradient; both arms pay identical extra forwards every 4 updates
intervention.no_claim: one seed and fixed budget do not establish convergence, superiority or universal tuning reduction

decision_rule: Reject if latch_calibrated_on freezes phase/rho or cannot release under fresh contrary evidence relative to matched calibrated off.
